name: conflict
description: Multiple reviewers disagree. One approved, one requested changes. Need to resolve disagreement.
expected_behavior: Present options for resolving disagreement: clarify priority, author chooses, escalate. Frame as trade-off.
scenarios: Both reviewers are right; it's a legitimate trade-off
Disagreement is about priority, not correctness
success_indicators: Options include: clarify, author decides, escalate
